import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)

# Define the cblas_dsymm function signature
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so")
cblas.cblas_dsymm.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_int,  # Order
    ctypes.c_int,  # Side
    ctypes.c_int,  # Uplo
    ctypes.c_int,  # M
    ctypes.c_int,  # N
    ctypes.c_double,  # alpha
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),  # A
    ctypes.c_int,  # lda
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),  # B
    ctypes.c_int,  # ldb
    ctypes.c_double,  # beta
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),  # C
    ctypes.c_int   # ldc
]

# Function to perform symmetric matrix-matrix multiplication
def symmetric_matrix_multiply(Order, Side, Uplo, M, N, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, ldc):
    # Convert NumPy arrays to ctypes arrays
    A_ctypes = A.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    B_ctypes = B.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    C = np.zeros((M, N), dtype=np.float64)
    C_ctypes = C.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))

    # Call the cblas_dsymm function
    cblas.cblas_dsymm(
        Order, Side, Uplo, M, N, alpha, A_ctypes, lda, B_ctypes, ldb, beta, C_ctypes, ldc
    )

    return C

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple symmetric matrix multiplication
    A = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [2.0, 3.0]], dtype=np.float64)  # Symmetric matrix
    B = np.array([[4.0, 5.0], [6.0, 7.0]], dtype=np.float64)
    alpha = 1.0
    beta = 0.0
    Order = 101  # CblasRowMajor
    Side = 141  # CblasLeft
    Uplo = 121  # CblasUpper
    M, N = 2, 2
    lda, ldb, ldc = 2, 2, 2

    C = symmetric_matrix_multiply(Order, Side, Uplo, M, N, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, ldc)
    expected_C = np.array([[16.0, 19.0], [26.0, 31.0]], dtype=np.float64)
    assert np.allclose(C, expected_C), f"Test case 1 failed: {C} != {expected_C}"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
